run::

mocks::
	go tool mockery --all --case underscore
---CONFIG---
gitClients:
  - baseUrl: https://gitlab.opencode.de
    tokenFile: secrets/glpat.secret
    type: gitlab
    maxRequestsPerSecond: 10
  - baseUrl: https://gitlab.dev.o4oe.de
    tokenFile: secrets/glpat-dev.secret
    type: gitlab
    maxRequestsPerSecond: 10
  - baseUrl: https://github.com
    tokenFile: secrets/ghpat.secret
    type: github
    maxRequestsPerSecond: 10
# we are currently using the badge-api main ci image in the gitlab ci. Thus we should use the main config as well.
remoteConfigURL: https://gitlab.opencode.de/open-code/badgebackend/badge-config/-/raw/main/.badge-api.yaml
subsequentUseApiDomain: https://software.opencode.de---MAIN---
// Copyright 2025 Zentrum für Digitale Souveränität der Öffentlichen Verwaltung (ZenDiS) GmbH.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

package main

import (
	"os"
	"runtime/pprof"

	"github.com/joho/godotenv"
	"gitlab.opencode.de/open-code/badgebackend/badge-api/cmd"
)

func main() {
	// read environment variables from .env file
	// and set them as env variables.
	godotenv.Load() // nolint:errcheck

	if os.Getenv("ENABLE_PROFILING") == "true" {
		f, err := os.Create("cpu.prof")
		if err != nil {
			panic("could not create CPU profile")
		}
		defer f.Close()

		if err := pprof.StartCPUProfile(f); err != nil {
			panic("could not start cpu profile")
		}
		defer pprof.StopCPUProfile()
	}

	cmd.Execute()
}

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat Makefile && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat .badge-api.yaml && echo "---MAIN---" && cat main.go
